# Goldens TestSelfhostWasm expects to be unsupported on wasm (2026-10-29).
# A golden that is not listed and becomes unsupported fails the test, so a
# regression such as 0.34.0's (Chan programs refused for wasm for twelve days)
# cannot hide in the unsupported count. Reason after the name, for reading only.

cmd_inherit # the wasm backend does not support processes (`proc.exec`): WASI preview1 has none
conn_deadline # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
conn_iface # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
dns_records # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
fs_atomic # operation not supported (WASI has no file modes or locks): write_atomic's mode
fs_cwd_path # no working directory under WASI
fs_dir_errors # operation not supported (WASI has no file modes or locks)
fs_files # operation not supported (WASI has no file modes or locks)
fs_mkdir_mode # operation not supported (WASI has no file modes or locks): create_dir_all_mode
fs_ops_edges # WASI has no times before 1970
handle_drop_leak # the wasm backend does not support processes (`proc.spawn`): WASI preview1 has none
http_client # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets

# The native heap's big blocks (rt.heap_big in alloc.alloc) have no wasm lowering:
debug_routes # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc
http_handler_fault # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc
http_router_hooks # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc; until rt.heap_big on wasm
http_router_paths # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc
metrics_text # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc
trace_ring # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.heap_big` (stage 2), in alloc.alloc
